data.description:
## Testing Mode: UPDATE

Add .sprint-active marker lifecycle to sprint SKILL.md Phase A (create) and Phase I (remove). Write structural tests asserting the SKILL.md contains the lifecycle instructions.

## SKILL.md Phase A Addition

After the WORKTREE_TRACKING:start comment block in Phase A (Validate Primary Ticket section), add:

```bash
# Create sprint-active marker to enable session-worktree merge-only enforcement
touch "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.sprint-active"
```

With an explanatory sentence: "The .sprint-active marker is gitignored and scoped to the session worktree. It enables the session-merge-only-check pre-commit hook. Phase I removes it."

## SKILL.md Phase I Addition

At the top of Phase I (Primary Ticket Closure), before delegating to /dso:end-session, add:

```bash
# Remove sprint-active marker — session complete
rm -f "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.sprint-active"
```

With sentence: "Remove the .sprint-active marker so post-session commits (e.g., release pipeline) are not blocked by the merge-only hook."

## Structural Test

Create tests/hooks/test-sprint-skill-sprint-active-lifecycle.sh with 4 assertions:
1. SKILL.md contains 'touch ... .sprint-active' (Phase A marker creation)
2. SKILL.md contains 'rm -f ... .sprint-active' (Phase I marker removal)
3. SKILL.md contains '.sprint-active' in context of Phase A
4. SKILL.md contains '.sprint-active' in context of Phase I

## .test-index Update

Add rows:
```
plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md | tests/hooks/test-sprint-skill-sprint-active-lifecycle.sh
```
(merge with existing SKILL.md row if present)

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md (modify)
- tests/hooks/test-sprint-skill-sprint-active-lifecycle.sh (create)
- .test-index (modify)
